## Problem

<!-- The problem in a sentence or two: what happens, what should happen, how to reproduce it. -->

<!-- How this fixes it. If it spans the island, the tray icon, the hook or startup, say why each is needed. -->

UI changes: before/after screenshots. Motion or timing: a short recording. Upload them here; never
